name: Gamaliel
summary: A Pharisee on the council, a teacher of the law respected by all the people. He warned the council not to fight against God, and Paul was taught the law under him.

key_moments.title: Wise Words to the Council
key_moments.description: When the council wanted to kill the apostles, Gamaliel had them sent out and told the council to leave them alone. If this work was of men it would come to nothing, he said, but if it was of God they could not overthrow it.

key_moments.title: Paul's Teacher
key_moments.description: Paul told the crowd that he was born in Tarsus but brought up in their city, trained under Gamaliel in the strict ways of the law of their fathers.
